metadata.source: California Attorney General CCPA Enforcement Case Examples
metadata.note: Cases updated after 01/01/2023 enforcement change: no longer requires notice/cure period before filing action

cases.title: Online Retailers - Opt Out Procedures and GPC
cases.issue: Failure to honor consumer opt outs of sales
ccpa_violations: Failed to honor Global Privacy Control (GPC) opt-out signals
Did not offer opt-out mechanism for sales
Did not ensure third parties were CCPA-compliant service providers
remedial_actions: Reviewed and updated service-provider contracts
Implemented technology to communicate restricted use signal
Blocked transfers upon GPC detection

cases.title: Loyalty Programs - Financial Incentive Notices
cases.industry: Retail (clothing, home goods, food, hospitality, home improvement)
cases.issue: Noncompliant Notice of Financial Incentive
ccpa_violations: Operating loyalty programs with financial incentives without compliant notice
Did not obtain proper opt-in consent
Did not clearly disclose material terms
remedial_actions: Posted Notice of Financial Incentive at point of sale
Added deep links to online notices
Redesigned enrollment to capture express opt-in consent
Added ability to withdraw from program anytime

cases.title: Weblink Shortener - Privacy Policy and Request Methods
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy and No Request Methods
ccpa_violations: Did not provide notice of CCPA consumer rights (right to know, delete, non-discrimination)
Did not disclose request methods for exercising rights
Did not state whether personal information was sold
No clear Do Not Sell My Personal Information link
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with required CCPA rights
Implemented two request methods for consumers
Added compliant opt-out link

cases.title: Healthcare Services - Request Processing Errors
cases.issue: Erroneous Treatment of Requests to Know
ccpa_violations: Incorrectly treated requests to know as requests to delete
Permanently deleted personal information in error
Insufficient staff training on CCPA requirements

ci_parameters.subject: Patients
ci_parameters.consent: Patients have right to access their information

remedial_actions: Implemented staff training on CCPA requirements
Refined request response process
Separated right to know from right to delete procedures

cases.title: Medical Device Manufacturer - Privacy Policy and Opt-Out
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Required Waive/Limit CCPA Rights; Limited Requests; Sale of PI
ccpa_violations: Required acceptance of terms to exercise CCPA rights
Limited to one request per 12 months
Confusing disclosures regarding data sales
No mechanism to opt-out of sale
Directed to third-party tool instead of providing direct opt-out
remedial_actions: Removed conditions on exercising CCPA rights
Added Do Not Sell My Personal Information link
Updated data sale disclosures

cases.title: Telehealth Portal - Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Non-Compliant Notice of Collection
ccpa_violations: Link to notice at collection directed to wrong section
Privacy policy lacked required information disclosures
Did not describe information needed for verifiable consumer request
Did not list categories of personal information collected
Did not list categories of third parties for disclosures
remedial_actions: Deep-linked notice to relevant privacy policy section
Updated privacy policy with required disclosures
Listed categories of personal information collected
Listed categories of third parties

cases.title: Fitness Center Chain - Website Opt-Out and Cookie Options
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process
ccpa_violations: Confusing opt-out interface with unclear toggle language
Reverse toggle logic (on meant opt-in to sale, off meant opt-out)
Double negative confusing consumers
Directed to third-party trade association tool

ci_parameters.subject: Consumers
ci_parameters.consent: Confusing opt-out mechanism prevented true consent

remedial_actions: Simplified opt-out language and options
Removed double negatives
Replaced confusing dropdown with simple toggle
Improved clarity on which setting effectuates opt-out

cases.title: FinTech for Minors - Privacy Policy and Required Links
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process; Missing Notice
ccpa_violations: No notice at collection about categories of PI collected
Did not state whether personal information was sold
Mobile app lacked notice at point of collection
For minors under 18, special data protections required
remedial_actions: Segregated data for minors under 18
Clearly stated no sale of minors' data
Added Do Not Sell link for 18+ users
Added notice at collection in mobile app

cases.title: People Search Company - Opt-Out and Verification Procedures
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process and Verification Procedures
ccpa_violations: Do Not Sell link worked only on certain browsers
Opt-out directed to confusing webpage with multiple steps
Required onerous verification process
Only one method to submit CCPA requests
Required terms/privacy acceptance to submit requests
Unclear if account creation required
Did not properly disclose CCPA metrics

ci_parameters.subject: Individuals in people search database
ci_parameters.consent: Burdensome opt-out process prevented effective opt-out

remedial_actions: Fixed Do Not Sell link to work on all browsers
Simplified opt-out process
Eliminated verification for opt-out/delete
Provided multiple request submission methods
Updated CCPA metrics disclosure

cases.title: Clothing Retailer - Opt-Out Mechanism
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process
ccpa_violations: Do Not Sell link led to cookie management popup only
Did not provide mechanism to stop sale of personal information
Conflated cookie management with CCPA opt-out
remedial_actions: Added separate button to opt out of sale of personal information
Distinguished opt-out from cookie preferences
Offered both non-Californians and Californians opt-out

cases.title: Technology Platform - Authorized Agent Procedures
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out and Request to Know Process
ccpa_violations: Did not allow consumers to submit opt-out via authorized agents
Did not allow requests to know via authorized agents
Staff not trained on CCPA requirements
No process to direct consumers to exercise their CCPA rights

ci_parameters.subject: Consumers
ci_parameters.consent: Authorized agents unable to act on consumer behalf

remedial_actions: Implemented authorized agent request procedures
Updated privacy policy to describe agent procedures
Conducted staff CCPA training
Implemented technical solution for GPC (California IP detection)

cases.title: Wireless Network Provider - Request Procedures
cases.issue: Consumer Requests to Know and Delete; Noncompliant Opt-Out Process
ccpa_violations: Non-functional CCPA portal
Not accepting requests to know and delete
Non-functional GPC processing

ci_parameters.subject: Customers
ci_parameters.consent: System failures prevented right to know/delete

remedial_actions: Made CCPA portal functional
Implemented working request processes
Enabled GPC request processing

cases.title: Online Advertising Firm - Privacy Disclosures and Opt-Out
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy and Opt-Out of Sale Process
ccpa_violations: Privacy disclosures not easy to read or understand
Lacked required information in privacy policy
Opt-out method confusing with dysfunctional links
remedial_actions: Revised privacy policy with clear language
Hired UX designer to improve opt-out method
Fixed dysfunctional links

cases.title: Marketing Company - Service Provider Status
cases.issue: Notice to Consumers
ccpa_violations: Did not provide required notices to consumers
Did not provide methods to submit consumer requests

ci_parameters.subject: Consumers
purposes: Email marketing on behalf of customers

remedial_actions: Provided evidence of service provider status
Confirmed non-use of data across multiple customers
Updated terms of service with CCPA service provider obligations
cases.note: Ultimately compliant as service provider, not business

cases.title: Social Media Network - Service Provider Contracts
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Service Provider Contracts
ccpa_violations: Service provider contracts lacked CCPA-specific restrictions
Did not prohibit service providers from retaining/using/disclosing PI

ci_parameters.subject: Users
ci_parameters.consent: Service provider obligations not contractually enforced

remedial_actions: Added CCPA-specific addendums to service provider contracts

cases.title: Online Event Sales Company - Privacy Policy and Request Methods
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Lack of Request Methods
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
Did not disclose request methods
No clear statement on whether personal information sold/transferred
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with CCPA rights
Implemented two request methods
Stated whether PI was sold/transferred
Clarified no sale of personal information

cases.title: Online Dating Platform - Do Not Sell Link and Sales Disclosures
cases.issue: No Do Not Sell My Personal Information Link; Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No Do Not Sell link on homepage
Inadequate disclosures about sold personal information
Accept sharing button gave blanket consent to sale

ci_parameters.subject: Dating app users
ci_parameters.consent: Blanket consent via single button was insufficient

remedial_actions: Added clear Do Not Sell link to homepage
Updated privacy policy with compliant sales disclosures

cases.title: Online AdTech Service Provider/Business - Privacy Policy and Contracts
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Non-Compliant Service Provider Contracts
ccpa_violations: Privacy policy did not clearly distinguish service provider vs. business roles
Service provider contracts lacked necessary restrictions

ci_parameters.subject: Consumers
ci_parameters.consent: Role confusion prevented proper CCPA compliance

remedial_actions: Clarified business vs. service provider roles
Stated no sale of personal information
Provided accessible CCPA request methods
Updated service provider contracts with CCPA restrictions

cases.title: Online Social Media App - Timely CCPA Responses
cases.issue: Untimely Responses to CCPA Requests
ccpa_violations: Not timely responding to requests to know and delete
No acknowledgment of receipt of requests
No notification that requests were effectuated
remedial_actions: Responded to outstanding requests
Updated CCPA response system
Ensured timely acknowledgment and response
Implemented notification system

cases.title: Children's Toys Distribution Company - Privacy Policy
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Lack of Request Methods; Charging Fees
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
No methods to submit requests to know and delete
Did not list categories of personal information disclosed
Did not state whether PI was sold
Claimed could charge fees for requests to know
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with all required CCPA notices
Removed claim to charge fees

cases.title: Grocery Chain Loyalty Program - Notice of Financial Incentive
cases.issue: No Notice of Financial Incentive
ccpa_violations: Loyalty program exchanged personal information for incentive
Did not provide Notice of Financial Incentive
remedial_actions: Added Notice of Financial Incentive to privacy policy

cases.title: Online Classified Advertisements Company - Privacy Policy
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
Did not state whether PI was sold or transferred for business purpose
First update failed to meet readability standards (jargon-heavy)
Required second notice for non-compliance
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with required CCPA rights
Identified categories of PI transferred for business purpose
Stated no sale of personal information
Significantly revised policy for readability after second notice

cases.title: Media Conglomerate - Opt-Out Process and Notices
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process; Notices to Consumers
ccpa_violations: No methods to opt-out of sale of personal information
Only directed to third-party trade association tool
Privacy policy lacked required opt-out information
No Do Not Sell link on multiple digital properties
remedial_actions: Updated opt-out process with direct company opt-out
Updated privacy policy and notices
Added Do Not Sell link to all digital properties

cases.title: Data Broker - Opt-Out Method
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process
ccpa_violations: Opt-out process directed only to mobile device settings
Webform did not clearly state it effectuates CCPA opt-out
Confusing about relationship between device settings and CCPA opt-out
remedial_actions: Updated webform to prominently feature it
Clarified webform allows full CCPA opt-out
Distinguished device settings from CCPA opt-out

cases.title: Automotive Business - In-Person Notice, Privacy Policy, Request Methods
cases.issue: Notices to Consumers; Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Lack of Toll-Free; Defective Methods
ccpa_violations: Failed to provide notice at collection for test drive data
Privacy policy lacked CCPA rights description
No instructions for authorized agents
No toll-free number for CCPA requests
Online request methods were non-functional

ci_parameters.subject: Test drive participants
information_types: Personal information collected at test drive

remedial_actions: Implemented notice at collection for test drives (online and in-person)
Updated privacy policy with CCPA disclosures
Added toll-free phone number
Fixed non-functional online request methods

cases.title: Pet Industry Website - Authorized Agent and Sales
cases.issue: Authorized Agent; Sales of Personal Information
ccpa_violations: Required notarized verification for authorized agents
Confusing disclosures about data sales
No mechanism to opt-out of sale
Directed to third-party tool instead of direct opt-out
remedial_actions: Removed notarization requirement for agents
Added Do Not Sell link
Updated opt-out webform
Clarified full opt-out for all sales

cases.title: Grocery Chain - Authorized Agent Disclosures
cases.issue: Authorized Agent; Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No information about authorized agents submitting requests
Other privacy policy omissions
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy to explain authorized agent procedures
Included business requirements for verifying agent requests

cases.title: Mobile App Game - Sales of Minors' Personal Information
cases.issue: Sales of Personal Information; Sales of Minors' Personal Information
ccpa_violations: Installed third-party advertising software
Made available PI of minors (aged 13-15)
No opt-out mechanism for adults
No opt-in for minors

ci_parameters.subject: Game players (including minors)
ci_parameters.consent: No mechanism for minors; no opt-out for adults

remedial_actions: Removed third-party advertising software
Implemented age-gating
Added parental verification features

cases.title: Social Media Company - Privacy and Data Sales
cases.issue: Notices to Consumers; Sales of Personal Information
ccpa_violations: Did not inform consumers about CCPA rights
Exchanged user data with analytics providers
No notices to consumers
No opt-out of sale mechanism
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with CCPA rights
Removed all third-party trackers

cases.title: Electronics Manufacturer and Retailer - Sales of Personal Information
cases.issue: Sales of Personal Information
ccpa_violations: Third-party trackers on website shared data with advertisers
No service provider contracts with third parties
Did not process Global Privacy Control opt-out requests

ci_parameters.subject: Website shoppers
ci_parameters.consent: No GPC processing; no consent mechanism

remedial_actions: Worked with privacy vendor to effectuate GPC opt-outs
Avoided sharing data with third parties without proper agreements

cases.title: Media Conglomerate - Opt-Out and DNSMPI Links
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Opt-Out Process; Lack of Request Methods
ccpa_violations: Required separate requests per website for opt-out
No Do Not Sell link on multiple digital properties
remedial_actions: Streamlined opt-out process
Added Do Not Sell link to all digital properties

cases.title: National Grocery Chain - Privacy Policy
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No privacy policy disclosing PI collection and use
No notice of CCPA rights
No information about request submission methods
No statement about PI sales/transfers
remedial_actions: Posted privacy policy with required CCPA information
Implemented consumer request processes
Stated no sale of personal information

cases.title: Email Newsletters Platform - Privacy Policy and Request Methods
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
Inadequate information about request submission
No statement about PI sales/transfers
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with CCPA rights
Listed PI transferred for business purpose
Specified request submission methods
Stated no sale of personal information

cases.title: Online Event Sales Company (alternate) - Privacy Policy
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Lack of Request Methods
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
No information about exercising CCPA rights
No statement about PI sales/disclosures
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with required CCPA information
Confirmed no sale of personal information

cases.title: Digital Partner - Privacy Policy and Rights Disclosure
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Notices to Consumers; No DNSMPI Link
ccpa_violations: Privacy policy did not disclose CCPA rights
Inadequate notice on PI collection/use/sale
No way to submit requests (phone or website)
No Do Not Sell link
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with CCPA rights
Added Do Not Sell link
Provided phone and email for requests
Added telephone request method

cases.title: Data Broker - DNSMPI Link, Verification, and Account Requirements
cases.issue: No Do Not Sell Link; Verification; Account Creation
ccpa_violations: Non-functional Do Not Sell link
Required government ID copies and address verification for opt-out
Required account creation for requests
Onerous verification process
remedial_actions: Fixed Do Not Sell link
No longer requires verification for opt-out
Eliminated account creation requirement

cases.title: Video Game Distribution Company - Privacy Policy
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
Did not list categories of disclosed PI
No statement about PI sales
Incorrect instructions for exercising rights
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with all required CCPA information
Corrected request procedures

cases.title: Education Technology Company - Privacy Policy and DNSMPI
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy; Lack of Request Methods; No DNSMPI Link
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
No methods to submit requests
Did not list categories of disclosed/sold PI
No non-discrimination notice
No Do Not Sell link on homepage
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with full CCPA disclosures
Added Do Not Sell link to homepage

cases.title: Clothing Retailer (alternate) - Privacy Policy and Request Methods
cases.issue: Non-Compliant Privacy Policy
ccpa_violations: No notice of CCPA consumer rights
No information about submitting requests
No statement about PI sales/transfers
remedial_actions: Updated privacy policy with CCPA rights
Listed PI transferred for business purpose
Specified request submission methods
